changelog: FIX (Fresh-install Fire Stick crash loop — irandall16@hotmail.com): v1.44.122's Lite-mode auto-migration only fired for users currently on PRO. Users who uninstall + reinstall start with mode=UNSET, the migration was skipped, and MainActivity defaulted UNSET to Pro UI → onCreate OOM-killed on tight-heap Fire Sticks before the activity could attach. v1.44.123 fixes both ends: (a) migration now also fires for UNSET users, (b) MainActivity falls back to DeviceCapability.detect() when savedMode is UNSET — never composes the Pro UI for a device the detector recommends as Lite.

PERF (Application.onCreate deferred init): All non-critical onCreate work — XtreamApi disk cache, CrashReporter upload, ExitInfoCollector, ThemePackLoader, AnrWatchdog — moved off the main thread into a HandlerThread that fires ~50ms after onCreate returns. Main-thread init now finishes in <50ms so the activity window can attach + first frame can render before the heavyweight init completes. Stops kernel OOM-killers from terminating the process before the splash ever shows on AFTKRT / AFTSSS class devices.

DIAGNOSTIC: 9 new granular boot marks in Application.onCreate (app_oc_post_crashhandler, app_oc_post_migration, app_oc_post_eventlog, app_oc_post_xtream_cache, app_oc_post_crash_upload, app_oc_post_exit_collector, app_oc_post_themepack, app_oc_post_anr_watchdog, app_oncreate_end). Next death's boot_died trace will pinpoint the EXACT line dying instead of just 'somewhere in the first 8 calls'.

DIAGNOSTIC: All crash / exit-info / boot_died reports now include app_mode (LITE/PRO/UNSET) and migration_state (migrated_v122/pristine). Admin Crashes tab can finally distinguish 'Pro UI killed a device' from 'Lite UI killed a device' and see whether the v1.44.122/123 auto-migration actually took effect for the dying user.
FIX (v522 — Fire Stick crash storm root cause): Removed AMAZON from premium-brand bypass list, added memoryClass≥192 MB as real capability gate.
MIGRATION (v522): One-shot silent Pro→Lite migration for existing Fire Stick users.
DIAGNOSTIC (v521): NEW BootPhaseTracker for ALL API levels.
DIAGNOSTIC (v521): ExitInfoCollector hardening — persist to disk before upload.
FIX (v519): Memory-trimmed Pro mode for 1 GB Fire Sticks.
FIX (v517): Navigation Compose bump for BACK-button crash.
FIX (v516): 4 Movie/Series crashes on weak Fire Sticks.
FIX (v515): 'Switch to Lite Mode' instant takes effect.
FIX (v514): Permanent ANR fix via Moshi codegen.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
